c.description: Beautifully renovated, furnished 2-bedroom + den / 2-bath suite in Vancouver's West End. Approx. 1,100 sq ft with high ceilings, hardwood floors, and air conditioning. Living area opens onto a covered 10' x 10' landscaped patio with gas fireplace. Primary bedroom with walk-in closet and private ensuite. Second bedroom unfurnished — use as bedroom, office, or both. Separate den/office, in-suite laundry, 1 secure underground parking stall. Steps to Sunset Beach and the Seawall; easy walk or bike to Stanley Park and downtown. Available October 1. Utilities not included. Pets may be considered. Tenant insurance, good credit, and landlord references required. Full listing with photos: https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/item/1441786767816716/
